candidates.label: Exterior HVAC condenser
candidates.systemReceiver: room climate / air-quality coverage and equipment state
candidates.floorConsequence: rated coverage, equipment noise, and a named outage or degraded zone
candidates.humanConsequence: people seek, avoid, report, or repair a visibly uncomfortable/noisy condition

candidates.label: Wall surveillance camera
candidates.floorConsequence: visible field of view, blind spots, and occlusion by walls or tall landscape
candidates.humanConsequence: witness exposure and observed behavior change by person and context

candidates.label: Occupancy / access sensor
candidates.floorConsequence: a bounded detection zone distinct from camera sight
candidates.humanConsequence: entry and attendance become legible records without pretending to know intent

candidates.label: Connected privacy hedge
candidates.systemReceiver: pathing, sightline, witness exposure, and camera occlusion
candidates.floorConsequence: blocks movement and divides visible/observed space without becoming a wall
candidates.humanConsequence: creates private paths and outdoor gathering edges while also hiding activity

deferredNonSystemGaps: fire hydrant or transformer without a corresponding system
proofGates: rated, degraded, and inoperative state reads
